The second condition means that the flat de Rham class itself lies in the indicated Hodge filtration. Then, after shrinking S, there is a coherent S-flat sheaf F on X, with F|X0 ≃ F0, for which chB,k(F|Xs ) = βB,k(s) (s near 0, k ∈ I). (7.20) These classes are rational algebraic cycle classes.
